verdict.rationale: The only status-related capability is the portal's offer to look up customs-clearance information for your postal parcel (docs-4), a case-like status check on the product's own pages. Nothing shows founders can check the status of tax filings, applications or cases, and the login/registration entry points (docs-5) suggest most lookups sit behind authentication rather than on public pages. The service-unavailability notice (docs-12) is about system uptime, not case status, so it does not count. missing for 10: evidence of filing/application/case status lookup for tax matters, confirmation that lookup works from public (unauthenticated) pages, detail on what status information is shown, independent or hands-on corroboration.
